Shaan Decor — Wedding Decoration, Chandigarh

Shaan Decor is a Chandigarh-based decorator offering traditional and semi-modern
wedding setups — floral mandaps, stage decor, and entrance arrangements — for
weddings across Punjab and the tricity area.

Their standard decor packages start at ₹1,60,000, with premium themed setups at
₹3,20,000. Lighting and seating decor can be added on request.

Contact: +91 97800 41267 · info@shaandecor.example
Location: Sector 35, Chandigarh
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (118 reviews)

What couples say:
"Clean, elegant decor and very punctual setup."
"Good balance of traditional and modern elements."

Shaan Decor is a reliable mid-range choice and is experienced with both gurudwara
and banquet-hall weddings across the tricity region.
